## What we know

- **Name:** 熙春园 / 清华园 Xichun Yuan, Qinghua Yuan (S1219, S1206, S02 · confidence B)
- **In English:** Garden of Bright Spring (Tsinghua's 工字厅) (S1219, S1206, S02)
- **What it was:** a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls (S1219, S1206, S02 · confidence B)
- **In 1860:** held by 奕誴 (惇亲王 line, from 1846), named 清华园 by Xianfeng; spared in 1860 (S1219; S1206) (S1219, S1206, S02)
- **Where:** osm way 659826161 (工字厅, historic=building) centroid; its extent, a circle of 200 m, is assumed (S1219, S1206, S02 · confidence B)
- **Note:** 1707 for 诚亲王胤祉; a garden of 圆明园 under Qianlong (lead); 1822 the east part (涵德园) to 惇亲王绵恺. 清华学堂 opened in it 1911 (S02 pp.215-216: 'country seat of Prince Tun'). Survives: 工字厅, 古月堂. The historic=manor way 1369111544 (1.3 ha) is only the 工字厅 court. (S1219, S1206, S02)
